# @vllnt/convex-wallet

> TypeScript Convex component for virtual currency wallets: coin, credit and energy balances with atomic spend, transfers, regen over time and a ledger.

Install `@vllnt/convex-wallet` (unreleased builds from `main` use the `canary`
dist-tag). Peer dependency `convex@^1.45.0`; optional `react >=18` for the
`./react` hooks; Node.js `>=20`. Mount it with `app.use(wallet)` from
`@vllnt/convex-wallet/convex.config` and call it through
`new Wallet(components.wallet, { currencies, defaultHistoryLimit })` from host
mutations and queries. Methods: `earn`, `grant`, `spend`, `transfer` (mutations)
and `balance`, `balances`, `history` (queries). Two sandboxed tables: `balances`
(one row per subject and currency) and `ledger` (one signed `delta` row per
change). `spend` and `transfer` never overdraw and return
`{ ok: false, code: "INSUFFICIENT" | "SELF_TRANSFER" }` instead of throwing.
Currency rules live in the client: `regen: { amount, intervalMs, cap }` refills
lazily from the server clock, `max` clamps credits. `grant` (and `earn` or
`spend` with `idempotencyKey`) applies once per key per subject and currency;
`transfer` has no key. Invalid input throws: `INVALID_AMOUNT` and
`INVALID_REGEN` as plain `Error`; `INVALID_ARGUMENT`, `INVALID_MAX`,
`INVALID_LIMIT`, `BALANCE_OVERFLOW` and `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED` as
`ConvexError` with `data.code`. `history` returns at most 1000 rows (default
50). An hourly internal sweep deletes ledger rows after 90 days and clears
idempotency keys after 7 days; neither is configurable. The host owns auth,
identity and payment verification; the component never processes payments.

## When to use

- Use it when users earn and spend an in-app currency (coins, gems, credits).
- Use it when a spend or transfer must never overdraw, even under concurrency.
- Use it when a currency refills over time up to a cap (energy, lives).
- Do not use it when the allowance resets on a schedule: use
  `@vllnt/convex-quota`.
- Do not use it when you bill recorded usage per period: use
  `@vllnt/convex-metering`.
- Do not use it when you track XP, levels or streaks that are never spent: use
  `@vllnt/convex-progression`.

## For coding agents

These docs are bundled in the package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-wallet/`
and match the installed version. Read them, and the shipped `src/`, before
writing code. The links below to `./` paths are files inside the installed package.
